title: Automorphism Groups of Uniform Dessins d'Enfants of Genus at Least Two
summary: For a smooth algebraic curve defined over a number field, one can associate a bipartite graph called a dessin d'enfant. We study the regularity and automorphism groups of dessins with uniform passports. In a previous paper, we proved that every passport of the form $[n,b^{q},n]$ of genus at least 2 admits a dessin with trivial automorphism group. Here we prove the analogous result for passports of the form $[b^{q},b^{q},n]$.
